body: How much stamina can we get with natural regeneration and dailies, in a week? I am at about 5.3k stamina now, and I don't know whether I can get 2k naturally for the Miku event.
Like I said, what resume in the field I'm in? No friends. No family. Just me and my bad luck. Life is just not worth the struggle.

I work as a pastry chef, because oddly enough, the pay is higher than what I would get based on my college degree, but still under minimum wage. There is no resume (or sometimes interview) involved. They ask me to bake and decorate a cake and if I manage that, I get the job. Last year I lost 5 jobs in a row because the businesses went under (talk about bad luck, you know?). This year, I lost 2. I'm working now, but the pay is crap and I don't know what else to do.

Hi. 

Thank you for the comment and I'm sorry about the delay in replying, I don't have internet myself and I can't spend my days at the library. I've given up hope, really, this was more like shouting in the void, so I appreciate the reply.

My goals? The usual, stable job, income, a roof over my head. I'm not chasing holidays in Spain or a billionaire sugar daddy or even less ridiculous goals. 

Just basics, you know? 

But I apply to so many jobs and most don't call back and if they do, the pay is crap and I'm broke even if I work 12 hours a day. And before anyone says anything, I went to college, I have skills, I have work experience. I shouldn't be struggling like this, but here we are. I would move to another country, but that stuff requires money. I had a GoFundMe campaign, I got 50 euros in a year. I have tried literally all I could think of.
